content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE official documentation, CPU/MPI and multi-GPU repositories, core TVD/Boussinesq/GPU papers, CACR lineage links and local wiki coverage를 정리한 web-reference note이다(1-45행). It records repository versions and language/release metadata (11-15행), technical attributions to Shi 2012, Wei 1995, Chen 2006, Kirby 1998 and Yuan 2020 (17-34행), then links model classification, XBeach-NH and local source/manual/bibliography notes (36-45행).
entities: dryuanye/FUNWAVE-GPU multi-GPU repository based on v3.3 (line 15)
Shi et al. 2012 Ocean Modelling TVD solver paper (lines 19-21)
Wei et al. 1995 and Chen 2006 Boussinesq lineage papers (lines 23-25)
Yuan et al. 2020 JAMES multi-GPU paper and claimed performance/validation (lines 30-34)
local model, XBeach, source-analysis, manual and foundational-paper references (lines 36-45)

unresolved: source provenance says WebFetch/WebSearch on 2026-06-12 and note_date is 2026-06-12 (lines 5-6), but the Boussinesq subsection claims DOI verification on 2026-06-15 (line 23) and the completion section covers 2026-06-13~15 (line 41). The record was updated after its declared note date without updating provenance date.

citation_status is globally verified (line 4), while source explicitly says some lineage papers are standard citations needing original-text confirmation (line 5), and the Shi paper entry still says original check recommended (line 20). Verification applies to metadata/landing pages, not necessarily the technical summaries.
GPU speedup is stated against a 36-core node as 4-7x single and >10x double (line 33), but problem size, CPU/GPU models, precision, measurement boundary and whether I/O is included are absent.

the CUDA description attributes a 20-30% reduction to a batched tridiagonal solver multi-GPU stream (line 32) without naming the baseline or metric; the causal/performance scope cannot be reconstructed from this note.

the coverage section fixes source-analysis at nine notes and 33,760 lines/218 subroutines (line 43). It is explicitly dated through 2026-06-15 (line 41), so later-added analyses make this count stale; no generated manifest anchors it.
XBeach-NH is called the same Boussinesq-type family (line 39), but no governing-equation or dispersion comparison is provided in this file.
